task.title: Validate scaling behavior with large root maps and many keydefs
task.shortdesc: Assess whether map size, key volume, or build parallelism affects consistent key resolution and pop-up generation.

step.cmd: Measure root map size (topicrefs, submaps) and count of keydefs to establish baseline complexity.
Search for repeated or patterned keys that could cause collisions when many submaps are combined.
Test builds with and without parallel processing to see if concurrency affects deterministic key resolution in your environment.
Split the root map into smaller submaps and confirm whether pop-ups work when processing a reduced scope.
Enable caching only if supported and stable for your toolchain, then verify cache invalidation does not preserve stale key resolution results.
Document a recommended maximum map/keydef size threshold if failures correlate with scale.

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
